Trending-Up.designated_by: Emmanuel Ebubembachu (pre-authorised 2026-08-17, strategy chosen by Claude)
Trending-Up.designated_reason: Best of 51 measured strategies on pooled OOS trades. It does NOT pass the gates: it fails OOS coverage at 46.35 months against the 60-month bar. It is the strongest available on every other axis - PF 1.61, Sharpe 1.22, MaxDD 12.4%, WinRate 44.7%, Recovery 3.64 over 114 OOS trades - and the only eligible strategy whose bootstrap CI on mean R clears zero, [+0.049,+0.620]. Tail dependence 18% and largest pair 24% across 5 pairs (4 of 5 profitable), so it is neither a lottery-tail nor a concentration artifact. Verified causal: no detect_swing_points, and its Butterworth filter is a strictly forward recursion. No individual regime-by-granularity cell passes, so vet.py yields 0 qualifiers; this designation rests on the POOLED verdict, a different and more lenient aggregation than the live-map cell path. PRACTICE ACCOUNT FORWARD TEST ONLY - evidence-gathering, not a proven edge. Owner pre-authorised publishing the best-ranked strategy before knowing which it would be.
